summary: Seed note. Nothing has been played and no character exists. The clock stands at d-1/night: the player has qualified and has not yet been posted. Run /first-through:start, build a character at the table -- there are no pre-gens -- and open on the light beats. Do not narrate before set-scene.
content:
This campaign has not begun. No character has been built and no scene has been set.

CHARACTER CREATION IS THE OPENING. Every character is built fresh, in three stages, out loud: Culture 100, Career 100, Bonus 150, and no more than 15 points into any one skill in any one stage. Six cultures and six careers in lore/character-creation/, one knack from the-knacks.md (which maps it to its Mythras power and rule id), and a fetch who is a person and gets its own NPC record. Pass --species humanoid to create-character; the default is avian and will give a child wings.

ONE ENTRY POINT: 'How Many' in lore/entry-points/ -- a door stuttering at the Nine with sixty-one people behind it, nineteen of them children, and adults who cannot be carried. It is Act I's turn and it arrives on d1. The first session before it is deliberately light: a ready room, a kettle argument, one short crossing that works.

Act I's beats are staged in the save in order; run list-beats and follow them. Acts II and III have prose in setting/story.md and no beats yet.

Read TABLE-ADDENDUM.md before the first roll. People die in this campaign, including the player's character -- but only from a risk the player could see when they chose it.
